Option 2 · Hosted control planes on bare metal
One infra router and one wildcard DNS record serve every hosted cluster: the hostname (TLS SNI) decides which cluster's Route gets the connection.
management and infrastructure in one cluster
Same ingress and storage paths as cluster A.
a node of guest cluster A; on the infra side it is a
3 control plane + N workers · OpenShift Virtualization · storage class (RWX block) backs every infra PVC
